comparisons.peer_topic: Measurement of Revenue and Variable Consideration
comparisons.peer_summary: Revenue is measured based on expected consideration, with variable consideration such as sales price concessions estimated using historical purchase volume data. Sales rebates are offset against receivables or recorded as other accrued liabilities if no receivable exists.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and INTC disclose accounting treatments for rebates and marketing development funds provided to customers. AVGO treats the 'off-market component' of these programs as part of customer contract valuation, valued at remaining unamortized balances approximating fair value. INTC treats sales rebates as variable consideration reducing revenue, offsetting them against receivables or recording them as accrued liabilities. While AVGO focuses on the valuation of the contract component's remaining life, INTC focuses on the recognition and offsetting mechanism of the rebate liability.
